label: orama.searchMovies.vectorSearch
reason: Orama hybrid+vector search now requests up to 2000 hits (was 1000). This can roughly double search work, increase latency, and increase the amount of vector data returned (includeVectors: true), amplifying downstream CPU/memory.

label: searchMovies.postProcess.levenshteinAndIndex
reason: Post-processing scales with number of hits: mapping hits->candidates, Levenshtein reranking over candidates, and building hitById map. With limit increased to 2000, this block can become a major CPU hotspot.

label: rateLimiterMiddleware.consume

label: rateLimiterMiddleware.error_handler
